text: Solicitors from Legal Services will deliver a presentation on the legislation governing the Property Standards Committee and its Hearings. The Property Standards Committee will meet in closed session on this item in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 which permits the closing of a meeting for the education or training of Committee members.
The Property Standards Committee: 1. Received the presentation (November 21, 2025) from the Solicitors, Legal Services for information.
